verdicts.reason: Both banners have the same structural problems. The legal fine print sits at the far left at roughly body-text size, so it competes with the headline. The logo is a faint speck, and the tilted 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon is jammed under the headline and nearly unreadable at 50 px tall. In B the ribbon is even smaller and illegible, and the headline 'last longer' runs right up against the CTA with almost no gap, so it's more cramped than A, where the ribbon is slightly bigger and the headline has a little room before the button.
